title: Phase 2: WorkerSession contract tests
description: Encode the existing ShellWorkerSession behavior as contract tests. Both ShellWorkerSession and OpenCodeServerSession must pass the same suite. This is the Phase 2 foundation: interchangeable backends.

packets.title: Write WorkerSession contract test suite
packets.objective:
Create tests/test_worker_session_contract.py. The suite defines a base TestWorkerSessionContract class with test methods for:

1. start() returns a SessionIdentity with session_id and backend fields
2. resume() returns the same identity when session is alive
3. resume() raises WorkerSessionNotFoundError when session is disposed
4. events() returns a list of WorkerEvent with monotonically increasing seq
5. events() with cursor=n returns events from cursor onward
6. snapshot() returns WorkerSnapshot with state, events_count, last_activity
7. cancel() sets is_alive() to False after completion
8. dispose() makes is_alive() return False and transcript() return None
9. is_alive() returns True for running sessions, False for disposed
10. transcript() returns a Path or None

Each test method receives a self.make_session() factory. Subclasses override make_session() to instantiate their backend (Shell or OpenCode).
acceptance_criteria: OpenCodeServerSession subclass passes all 10 tests (or is skipped with reason if server unavailable)

packets.title: Encode shell-adapter event behavior in contract tests
packets.objective:
Extend the contract test suite with event-behavior assertions that match the existing shell-adapter's expected event sequence:

1. SESSION_STARTED is always the first event (seq=0)
2. BRIEF_DELIVERED follows SESSION_STARTED
3. TEXT_DELTA events have non-empty data['text']
4. MESSAGE_COMPLETE has data['content'] with a non-empty string
5. TOOL_START has data['tool_name'] as a non-empty string
6. TOOL_END has data['tool_name'] matching its TOOL_START pair
7. FILE_CHANGE has data['path'] as a non-empty string
8. ERROR has data['message'] as a non-empty string
9. SESSION_ENDED is always the last event
10. No event has a duplicate event_id

The shell adapter must pass these assertions. Other backends may emit subsets of events — contract tests document which events are REQUIRED vs OPTIONAL per backend.
acceptance_criteria: 10 event-behavior assertions added to the contract test suite
Optional vs REQUIRED annotations on each event type
